note: S2, reproduced live. branch_name is only length-checked (ship-mode-select.js:21 / patch-compose.js:22), so `--upload-pack=/tmp/evil` returns `pass` from the validator documented as the PRE-GIT gate. The shipper then substitutes the value directly: adws-shipper.md:49,62 run `git push -u origin {branch_name}`, and SKILL.md:130 runs `git worktree add ... -b adws/{jobId}/{slug}`. A leading-dash value lands in argv option position and nothing in the spec constrains the agent's quoting. This is a command-safety validation gap, not a demonstrated injection — the validator executes no git — but the gate that exists to be checked before git should not pass a value that is unsafe where git receives it.
